Hero Section Generator

Design a hero section — headline, subtext, CTAs, gradient background — with live preview and HTML/CSS output.

📖 How to use

  1. Write your eyebrow, headline and subheadline.
  2. Add primary and secondary CTA buttons with links.
  3. Style the background gradient, text color and alignment.
  4. Copy the code or download the self-contained hero.html.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Can I use a background image instead of a gradient?

The generator produces gradients; you can replace the background rule with your own background-image URL afterwards.

Is it responsive?

Yes — the headline uses clamp() sizing and the layout centers on all screens.

Can I embed it in an existing page?

Copy the markup and the <style> block. All classes are prefixed with hs- to avoid collisions.

How do the buttons link?

Each CTA has its own URL field — fill it with the destination you want.
